{{Quote|Me kill many. Tired of lugging junk. You trade now!|Blearg|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Blearg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] who lived in the dangerous region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] known as the [[Outlaw's Den]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He and the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Kezzit]] made camp at the southeastern end of the area, and Blearg would trade loot he took from those he had [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blearg appears as a Black Market vendor in the Outlaw's Den, an open-world PvP zone on Tatooine in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
